admitted_label_requirements.authentic: A recorded source identifies the physical watch or the capturing organization, and a named verifier independent of this repository's folder names and independent of any model states that the watch is authentic, with the method and evidence identifier stored.
admitted_label_requirements.counterfeit: A recorded source identifies the item, and a named verifier independent of folder names and of any model states that it is counterfeit, with the method and evidence identifier stored.
admitted_label_requirements.otherwise: UNVERIFIED. Do not assign either class.

census_measurements_non_test_only: sha256 of the JPEG luminance and chrominance quantization tables

IJG quality estimate: for qualities 1 through 100, scale is 5000/q when q < 50 else 200-2*q; the estimate is the q whose scaled standard luminance table is closest in L1 distance to the file table. No quality cutoff is chosen from the labels.
JPEG progressive flag when Pillow exposes it

future_geometry_policy.exclusion: Collages, component-only images, non-watch placeholders, and ambiguous brand identity stay in expert review and are not admitted.
future_geometry_policy.grouping: A source group is the listing or product identifier. Exact SHA-256 duplicates stay in one group. Near-duplicates with no listing id stay unverified rather than being split apart.
future_geometry_policy.loader: Apply ResizePadToSquare, long side 512, bicubic, centered ImageNet-mean padding, identically to every class and every brand.
future_geometry_policy.splits: No train, calibration, validation, or test split is created in this phase.
future_geometry_policy.storage: Keep each admitted file at the geometry it had at acquisition. Do not pre-resize one class.

previously_identified_quarantine.source: Phase 47 artifacts. These identities are not part of the Phase 48 draw.

purpose: Define label verification and a class-independent dataset policy before any new training.
sample_measurements: mean and standard deviation of RGB
variance of the grayscale Laplacian as a sharpness statistic
standard deviation of the outer 8-pixel frame
visual notes on borders, padding, resizing, and interpolation

shortcut_test.forbidden: Do not fit a classifier, threshold, or quality cutoff on the labels.
shortcut_test.name: pre_specified_512_square_rule
shortcut_test.rule: Call the directory counterfeit label if and only if width is 512 and height is 512. This rule is fixed before the census is read. It is a measurement of association, not a trained classifier.

visual_sample.algorithm: Create random.Random(seed) once. For each brand in brands_in_order, then each label in labels_in_order, take eligible rows of that brand and label, sort by sha256 ascending, and draw per_cell rows with Random.sample.
visual_sample.eligible_rule: split is train, calibration, or validation. split == test is excluded and those image files are not opened.
